en.bdb: The apostate posseses everything but still is unhappy
In the month of savan, the whole forest becomes green but javels, a prickly plant remains dry.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਕੋ ਸਰਸਾ ਵਰਸਦੇ ਝੂਰੇ ਜੋਲਾਹਾ।
verses.translit_en: sabh ko sarasaa varasadhe jhoore jolaahaa|

en.bdb: During rains every one feels delighted but the weaver is seen gloomy.
In the night all the pairs meet but for chakavi , that is the time of separation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਖੁ ਸਮੁੰਦਹੁ ਸਖਣਾ ਰੋਵੈ ਦੇ ਧਾਹਾ।
verses.translit_en: sa(n)kh samu(n)dhahu sakhanaa rovai dhe dhaahaa|

en.bdb: The conch remains empty even in the ocean and cries when blown.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਹਹੁ ਉਝੜਿ ਜੋ ਪਵੈ ਮੁਸੈ ਦੇ ਫਾਹਾ।
verses.translit_en: raahahu ujhaR jo pavai musai dhe faahaa|

en.bdb: The man gone astray will definitely be robbed by putting rope around his neck.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਜਗ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬੇਮੁਖਾਂ ਨਿਤ ਉਭੇ ਸਾਹਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit_en: tiau jag a(n)dhar bemukhaa(n) nit ubhe saahaa ||5||

en.bdb: Similarly, the apostates go on sobbing in this world.
